research_question: Quando il modello generativo viene sostituito, l'accesso alla memoria esterna accumulata prima del passaggio permette al nuovo modello di continuare il lavoro rispettando obiettivi, correzioni, vincoli e stato delle attivita?

scope.architecture: Turn-level RAG over user messages only
scope.comparison_factor: memory accessible to model B (sessions 6-9 vs sessions 1-9)
scope.replications: one per model B, reported separately
scope.boundary: Controlled replacement of the generator above an explicit external memory; not a transfer of hidden internal state between models.

model_a.role: model of phase A (sessions 1-5); no new Claude generations are made and assistant messages are never indexed

excluded_claims: any model can replace any other in any task
general ranking of Gemma and Llama

models_reference.use: read-only source of tags, digests, quantization and runtime parameters for Gemma and Llama

handoff.description: Phase A (S1-S5) is the history before the change of generator; phase B (S6-S9 and final questions) is served by model B.

separated.description: retriever searches only user messages of sessions 6-9

shared.description: retriever searches user messages of sessions 1-9, including phase A

handoff_dependent.rule: at least one required fact comes from sessions 1-5

post_handoff_control.rule: all required facts come from sessions 6-9

absent_information.rule: no required fact; abstention expected in both conditions

retrieval.unit: single user message, rendered as in RQ2 mode T: '[message_id] content'
retrieval.ranking: scripts/rq2/rq2_common.py:rank_items (TF-IDF cosine of scripts/run_retrieval_pilot.py), imported not copied
retrieval.token_counting_scope: tokens of the rendered context line (identifier + content), as in RQ2
retrieval.truncation: none; the first item is included even if it alone exceeds the budget (RQ2 rule)
retrieval.no_post_hoc_tuning: Known lexical limits of TF-IDF on SC05 are not corrected.

prompt.origin: instructions of scripts/build_generation_inputs.py (pilot/RQ2) plus the JSON output contract of the RQ4 protocol
prompt.system:
Rispondi utilizzando soltanto le informazioni presenti nel contesto.
Non utilizzare conoscenze esterne e non inventare informazioni.
Se il contesto non contiene tutte le informazioni necessarie, dichiara che le informazioni disponibili non sono sufficienti.
Fornisci una risposta breve e diretta.
Restituisci soltanto un oggetto JSON con le chiavi "status" e "answer". Usa "status": "answered" quando il contesto consente di rispondere completamente. Usa "status": "insufficient" quando il contesto non consente di rispondere completamente e riporta in "answer" soltanto le eventuali informazioni supportate dal contesto, senza completare con supposizioni.

runtime.format: use prompt.response_schema as the Ollama format value

performance.limitation: Ollama size_vram is an allocation reported by the runtime, not measured peak RAM.

reuse.rule: Within the same model B, cells with identical prompt and identical model configuration get one real call; the others are 'reused_identical_prompt' with reused_from_cell_id. Never across Gemma and Llama. Decided from requests only, before any call.

counts.note: model_calls and reused_cells computed offline from the frozen retrieval on 2026-09-23: all 14 separated/shared context pairs differ, so no prompt is identical within a model.

evaluation.parser: strict: the whole text must be one JSON object with exactly the keys 'status' and 'answer'; status in response_schema enum; answer a string. Anything else is a format error. No repair, no retry.
evaluation.expected_status_rule: 'answered' when every required fact of the question is available (in the accessible corpus for expected_given_corpus, in the retrieved context for expected_given_context); otherwise 'insufficient'. Q7 has no required facts and is always 'insufficient'.
evaluation.fact_available_rule: a required fact is available when all its source messages are present (by provenance); provenance does not prove the content is usable and is not a judgment

classes.complete_supported: all required facts that are accessible and asked are reported correctly
classes.partial: at least one required fact is correct but another accessible one is missing
classes.wrong: contradiction, obsolete fact presented as current, or failure despite sufficient evidence
classes.insufficiency_recognized: correctly states that the context does not allow a complete answer and does not invent
classes.unsupported_claim: introduces a fact not present in the context

human_review.rule: Qualitative judgments stay null until the student fills and approves them; automatic flags never replace them.

automatic_flags.evidence_in_corpus: per required fact, source messages inside the accessible corpus
automatic_flags.evidence_in_context: per required fact, source messages inside the retrieved context
automatic_flags.obsolete_marker_mentioned: answer contains a marker listed in obsolete_markers (signal for review, not a judgment)
automatic_flags.unsupported_identifier_candidates: identifiers or numbers in the answer (salient_token_regex) that do not appear in the context

evaluation.forbidden_aggregation: Never average handoff-dependent questions, controls and absent information into one score; always show numerators and denominators.
evaluation.paired_comparison: question by question, shared vs separated, within the same model

smoke.purpose: optional check of runtime, format and parser; one call per model on a fixture that is not SC05

context_lines: [FIX-S1-U1] Il ticket di prova TST-3 riguarda la stampante del terzo piano ed è stato chiuso il 2 maggio.
fixture.question: Quando è stato chiuso il ticket TST-3?

evaluation_requires: results/rq4/sc05/v1/evaluation_gate.json approved and bound to current config and build manifest
execution_gates.phase1_rule: No real call and no raw_responses.jsonl in phase 1; smoke and evaluation must be authorized separately.
execution_gates.change_rule: Any change to prompt, retrieval, budget, parser, models or metrics after a real call requires a new config_id.
